اقتبسنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَسْنَا (iqtabasnā) /iq.ta.bas.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# اُقْتُبِسْنَا (uqtubisnā) /uq.tu.bis.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
